issues.detail: The Greek 'πολλω προσεχοντας' (pollo prosēchontas) means 'not giving much heed to/not being mindful of,' but the Vietnamese 'không chăm chú vào rượu nhiều' translates it as 'not paying much attention to alcohol.' While similar, the Greek construction implies a lack of preoccupation or 'heeding' rather than just 'paying attention' to the substance itself.
